sequential_dependency.intermediate: The complete post-recolor grid. Newly blue L-triominoes may merge with pre-existing blue components, so its blue-component partition differs from the input partition.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Recolor every yellow four-connected exact three-cell 2x2 L-triomino blue, leaving all other cells unchanged.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Recompute four-connected blue components on the Step-A grid, choose the unique largest by occupied-cell count, and recolor that whole component red.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step A changes blue membership and component sizes. In the selected qualified case, the input-grid largest and post-Step-A largest are different components; ranking before recoloring therefore paints a different final component.

parametric_work.summary: Canonical bytes preserved; largest/smallest post-recolor component ranking is demonstrated with matched inputs, four private queries, adversarial shortcut rebuttals, protected labels, and a wrong-order causal witness.
